# Bundled packages

The Typst packages an inkpdf template can import. They are built into the inkpdf server:
nothing is downloaded at render time, and no other package is available.

- Import a package by name only, exactly as in the table. Writing a version
  (`@preview/<name>:<version>`) or importing a package that is not listed makes the template
  invalid; the server uses the version shown here.
- Write the name as a literal string: `"@preview/" + name` is not supported. `#include`
  follows the same rules.
- A package only reads its own files: load images and data in the template, and pass them
  as arguments.
- **WASM**: the package runs a compiled plugin that cannot be interrupted. Keep its input
  small (a code to encode, not a whole document).

This list matches the inkpdf release of this plugin. A running server lists its own packages
at `GET /packages`.

| Import | Version | Purpose | WASM |
|---|---|---|---|

| `#import "@preview/cetz-plot"` | 0.1.4 | Plotting module for CeTZ. |  |

| `#import "@preview/frogst"` | 1.0.0 | Literal naming of numbers in French |  |
